canonicalIngredients.name: spring onion
observations: 15 g white part in sauce + garnish (s0)

causalSequence: combine soy, mirin, sugar (plus sake, ginger if using); heat to dissolve sugar
flatten thighs to even thickness; pat dry, season
sear thighs over medium-high, skin side first, ~3 min per side
pour sauce over chicken; simmer 3-5 min, basting until glossy glaze coats
if sauce thin, remove chicken and reduce 2-4 min over higher heat
serve over steamed rice with steamed greens; drizzle reserved glaze
techniqueFacts: all five sources use chicken thighs; two state breast dries out and needs thinning or overnight marinade
three sources hold soy + mirin + sake + sugar as the authentic sauce base; two US sources shortcut with sugar or honey plus soy only
glaze forms by reducing the sauce in the pan with the chicken, spooning it over for gloss (three sources)
two sources marinate 30 min to overnight instead of simmering sauce over the chicken
one source cooks skin-on thighs with no added oil, the skin renders its own fat; excess fat wiped away so sauce clings
one source strains ginger and spring onion out of the sauce before glazing
reserve a portion of sauce before it touches raw chicken to use as a safe drizzle (two sources)
mirin sub is 1 tsp sugar (one source); sake sub is extra mirin with sugar cut back (one source)
